reviews.text: The ‘Mary Poppins’ of dog walkers - Natasha, Caro and Natalie have been such a godsend to me and my 8 year old border terrier, Bingley. After just a few days in their care, I noticed how much calmer and happier he was and now a  month in, I can’t imagine what we’d do without them. Kind, caring and such a slick operation too, I couldn’t recommend them enough!

We can’t thank Natasha and her team at Happy Little paws, enough. We felt quite anxious to find the “right” dog walker for our precious dog, Birdie. Happy little paws, communicates, cares and we feel Birdie is getting everything she needs and more when with them. Our biggest regret is not contacting Natasha when Birdie was a puppy.
I would recommend them to anyone!!!

All photos attached are when Birdie is with them, look how happy she is!?!?!?

We’ve used Natasha/HLP with our Cavapoo dog Rudie since he was a puppy. I trust Natasha completely with Rudie, I know he is in the safest and most responsible of hands. Her communication is amazing, she replies quickly and we are always up to date. In winter Rudie is rinsed down after muddy walks too which is super amazing.
My husband and I absolutely love the content and photos which she works so hard to provide. Rudie has the best time and the walks are always varied so the dogs have so much fun together. I would never use another dog walker or dog sitter as Rudie’s bond with the walkers is something I wouldn’t want to take away from him. We are so happy we found such fantastic care for him, he really is a lucky boy.

Natasha and the team at Happy Little Paws take great care of our rescue dog, Sonny. We first met Natasha when Sonny was just 6 months old when we booked a training package. Later, Sonny joined the group walks and now regularly attends a couple of times each week. Despite Sonny’s initial overexcitement and difficulty focusing when on walks, Natasha has been patient and took a phased approach to introduce Sonny to the walks. He is now loving being part of the groups and his ability to be calm, focus and listen has improved massively.

Sonny absolutely loves Natasha and the team, and they love him too. We are lucky to have such a great local service and would recommend Happy Little Paws to anyone looking for a reliable dog walker.

Natasha and her team are the absolute best in the business! They are so incredibly lovely and dog loving but also ultra professional and truly care about the happiness of all of their furry customers. Couldn’t recommend them more! It’s so lovely knowing that your dog is having a wonderful time and getting looked after by someone who knows what they’re doing and loves them like their own. 👏👏👏

We used Natasha for some help training our 4 month old Schnockerpoo puppy Barney. He absolutely loves Natasha and looks forward to seeing her each week! He has made so much progress over our 4 puppyhood sessions with Natasha and is so much more confident with his training and walking. Natasha also lets us join some of her bigger dog walks to get Barney confident with other dogs after an attack. There have been so many valuable tips to make both ours and Barney’s life easier, and we would highly recommend Happy Little Paws for training, walking and looking after your pups!

Every Thursday Arlo waits at the window to be picked up and when Natasha and Caro arrive he absolutely loses it! He loves his weekly walks and has such a great time. Lots of happy howls from him and greats pics and videos for me! Very happy with HLP and would always recommend! I know he’s in great hands when he’s with them.

We used Natashas expertise for puppy training our new cockapoo Maisie. Natasha is very good with Maisie, she is like a dog whisperer! Maisie loves her and she listens and follows her commands. I have made vast improvements with my ability to train Maisie in all areas following Natashas recommendations. She offers valuable tips and insight and we have been very impressed and grateful for her time. I would highly recommend her for training, walking and looking after your dog.
Coco loves her weekly walk with Happy Little Paws. Natasha is organised, easy to deal with and clearly communicates any updates

Our working cocker spaniel walks with Natasha and it is the highlight of her week!  Natasha encourages positive social interactions and sniffing games rather than endlessly throwing balls as many walker do. She is completely knackered by the time she is dropped off! Our pup has also boarded with Natasha when we are on holiday. It is such comfort to know that she will be well looked after when we are away.

I couldn't recommend Happy Little Paws enough!

Natasha is amazing with my Cockapoo, and he is always so excited to see her and go on a walk with all of his friends. She is super reliable and great with communication, and you can tell that she genuinely loves all of the dogs that she works with!

Natasha is an excellent dog trainer. We re-homed our 8 year old Labrador from a very different living environment and the change caused her to be quite stressed to begin with. Natasha was extremely astute in diagnosing the root causes of certain difficult behaviours (e.g. mild aggression to other dogs on walks) and had a very effective and tailored plan to gradually build her exposure in a comfortable and controlled way. The change we’ve seen has been fantastic and our lab is now super happy and relaxed. We also use Natasha for a weekly dog walk which our dog absolutely loves and has been helpful in reinforcing some of the stuff we taught her in training. Would absolutely recommend Natasha.

Natasha walks my retriever 3 days a week and I cannot recommend her enough!! She is gentle and kind and so loving as well as keeps her dogs super safe that I never have to worry. Snow absolutely adores her. I couldn’t have asked for anything better. She is a true gem!

We’ve been with HLP for just under a year, she’s been great with our dogs, really cares for them and understands them so well being an experienced trainer. Has been so reliable and keen to fit extra days in where possible. Couldn’t ask for me! They love her and don’t come and hide upstairs from her when she comes to collect them like some of our previous walkers/daycare.
We generally left our dogs with dog sitters or daycare before and due to a full time return to the office this is our first proper regular walker we’ve had to fully rely on, she comes at just the right time that they’re ok at home on their own before and after the walk.
Regular instagram uploads and updates on the dogs! They seem to return clean and dry unlike some places where they come back wet, muddy and stinky.
I doubt you’ll find someone better locally and sending the dogs miles away with a big company isn’t for us.

Natasha has been walking our energetic cocker spaniel Rigby for over 2 years and he absolutely loves his time with her. She is communicative, caring and always shares great photos so we know how much fun Rigby’s had on his walk.
Natasha has been absolutely fantastic with our dog Minnie and has clearly formed a brilliant bond with her. She is extremely reliable and trustworthy.

Natasha has been great with Carmie. We did the puppy package with her and Carmie loved her so much that we arranged for her to have a couple of walks with Natasha every week. Carmie always gets a really good amount of exercise on the walks and Natasha is great at giving updates.

We started working with Natasha when our labrador puppy Frankie was just 8w old, and we couldn’t be happier with the experience. Natasha is everything you’d hope for in a dog trainer; calm, confident, incredibly knowledgeable, and genuinely caring. She has a really positive approach that works beautifully. Frankie took to her right away and absolutely lights up whenever she arrives.

Every session is focused and structured, but still relaxed enough that it feels fun for everyone, especially our dog. She doesn’t just train the puppy, she teaches you how to understand your dog’s behaviour and respond in the right way. That’s been invaluable for us as first-time puppy owners.

After each session, Natasha sends super helpful notes recapping what we covered and what to focus on next. She also checks in between sessions and is always happy to answer questions or give advice when something unexpected comes up.

We’ve seen such clear progress in Frankie since we started; but more than that, we’ve built a great relationship with our dog, and that’s largely thanks to Natasha’s support and approach.

Highly recommend Natasha and Happy Little Paws to anyone looking for a thoughtful, experienced trainer who truly understands and cares about dogs.

When Natasha first took hold of Maverick—my lanky, overexcited, borderline-deranged Weimaraner—I half expected her to invent a sudden emergency and flee. Instead, she performed what can only be described as alchemy. Within a few sessions, I was convinced she’d swapped him for a well-mannered clone. But no—after a heroic dive into a shrub and an ill-fated sprint after a leaf, I knew it was still him.

Thanks to Natasha’s blend of sorcery, snacks, and saintly patience, Maverick no longer treats walks as an extreme sport. The park still presents too many distractions for total grace, but there’s definite progress. Honestly, I might be the one in need of lessons now.

Absolutely love Hapoy Little Paws. We did the puppy training package and our pup absolutely fell in love with Natasha and she gave us the fundamental tools for puppyhood. We’re excited for more training over the summer! Seriously the care and attention, innate understanding and love she has for all doggos is evident. Perfect.

We booked Natasha for the puppy package to help with our Cavapoo Phoebe , Natasha was amazing and helped us so much. We are first time dog owners so felt a bit overwhelmed training Phoebe & weren’t sure where to start. Natasha was great and Phoebe absolutely adores her! We will definitely be purchasing some more training sessions with Natasha, highly recommend! Thank you! Lauren, James and Phoebe

We booked Natasha for her 5 session puppy package. I honestly don't know how we would have coped without her input! We haven't owned a dog before but our little Cockerdor Ada has been a delightful new member to our young family. Using Natasha's training exercises we have been able to channel Ada's energy into fun training games and avoid the extremes of puppy craziness! She was a great communicator and Ada instantly warmed and responded to her. Highly recommend.

Natasha has been so helpful with our reactive rescue Otis. When meeting him, she was very respectful of his boundaries and took the time to build his trust before helping us with some strategies for reducing some of his reactivity. She now does weekly training walks with him which he clearly loves as he gets so excited when he realises it's her at the door!

Nothing short of a miracle worker. Natasha has helped us communicate with our best friend Dudley, helping to improve his general obedience.

Within 20 minutes of meeting Dudley, Natasha had already built a strong relationship with him and had him doing commands we’d struggled with for months.

Thank you!
Natasha was a great help during a difficult time - can highly recommend!

Natasha has been brilliant with our puppy, Ponyo. Her approach to training is very generous and helps create a deep connection with your dog. Ponyo loves spending time with Natasha and her support and excellent training materials have given us the platform to ensure that she grows up into a lovely, well-trained dog!

I couldn't recommend Natasha and HLP more!

As first time dog owners, Natasha's puppy package was perfect for us to help us with Tobi - our cavapoo puppy! She took time to explain things, sent us clear and detailed one pagers on different trainings, super communicative in her training approach and tailored her sessions to Tobi's training needs. Highly recommend.

Natasha is brilliant, I did the puppy package with my working cocker Duke and then have continued to work with Natasha for walk training and doggy sitting. Duke loves Natasha and I feel really reassured he’s in great hands when he’s stays with her.

Natasha is so wonderful with our cockapoo Ruby. She is kind, calm and very loving but will also deal with any temperament issues and puts high quality dog care at the heart of her business. She also communicates very clearly and is very professional. We can't recommend her highly enough.

Our cockapoo Sydney absolutely adores Natasha. We cannot mention her name at home without him dashing to the window to see if she’s walking up to the front door. Totally recommend Natasha for walks, overnight stays and holidays. She treats all her dogs like they are her own and spends time getting to know their quirks. We always feel reassured he’s being looked after so well.

Our dog Juno loves Natasha at Happy Little Paws. She is reliable, calm and trustworthy and fantastic with dogs - her training skills are a bonus! She varies her walks and when Juno boards has a great balance of walking, rest and general strokes and love. We would recommend her highly!

Natasha at Happy Little Paws is a wonderful dog walker. Our dog goes away excited and comes back happy and tired. We really appreciate the updates and regular communication, and she always takes care of each dogs specific needs and temperaments. Highly recommend.

I’ve had a wonderful experience with Happy Little Paws! My dog Happy (no pun intended) struggles with serious leash reactivity. Working with Natasha his focus, reactivity and recovery times have improved unbelievably - I didn’t think I would see the day where he could go for a walk without prolonged episodes, and now he can!

Happy little paws has taught him so much, and he is like a different dog - so much calmer, able to focus and listen to commands. Could not recommend more highly! Natasha has taught Happy to have a confidence I never thought he could have 😊

We couldn't recommend Natasha and Happy Little Paws enough! Having recently moved to the area, Natasha has made sure that our dog has settled in well, as well as being there when we have needed her for both walks and sleepovers. She truly …
I came to Natasha after trying another trainer who we didn’t gel with, and she was a breath of fresh air. …

Natasha was really knowledgeable and helpful. She addressed all the training concerns I had with my new puppy in our session and followed up with an email reminding me of everything we’d gone through.
